name: remote-gtfs-v1
description: The community GTFS archives downloaded at runtime (remote-gtfs-v1.json of shared-data): which archives are read and refused (archives, built with Python's zipfile; builder marks the cases tools/build_ios_gtfs_schedule.py's BoundedGtfsArchive reads the same way, limits overrides the table's for the iPhone's reader), which catalogue stations a stop names (stationMatches: named on both platforms, bound the one the iPhone's index binds), and the trains of the operator a route finds (timetables: the fixture of Android's RemoteGtfsFallbackDataSourceTest).
